title: Applications Project — Start or Restart Terminal MCP via Terminals Issue #3
applicability: When developing or operating Applications project's registered @ functions and the Terminals MCP Codespace needs to be started or restarted.

execution_interface.method: Post the complete JSON request as a NEW issue comment authored by the repository owner. Issue #3 invokes .github/workflows/issue-3-comment-listener.yml and executes whatPrompt on the GitHub Actions runner. The runner is not the Codespace.
execution_interface.invocation_identity: Use a distinct forWhom on every call in the form <model>_<10-digit zero-padded prime>-<task>-Applications.

codespace.relationship: Starting the Codespace initiates its configured startup behavior, including launching the Terminal MCP service. No independent MCP process-restart command is required for the start operation.

start.purpose: Start the Terminals Codespace when stopped without modifying its files or rebuilding it.

alternative_existing_workflow.whatPrompt: gh workflow run codespace-mcp-watchdog.yml --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --ref main

start.important_distinction: Dispatch acceptance is not proof the Codespace is running. The watchdog workflow starts the Codespace through the Codespaces API using its configured CODESPACE_NAME.

restart.purpose: Stop an already running Codespace and start that SAME Codespace again, allowing its startup configuration to launch Terminal MCP.
restart.step_2_wait_for_stopped_state: Confirm that the Codespace status is ShutDown (or the documented stopped status) before starting it. A stop API success response alone does not establish shutdown completion. Inspect state with the Issue #3 command: gh api 'user/codespaces/shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96' --jq '.state'.
restart.sequence_requirement: Do not issue stop when the user only requests start. Do not submit start until the stop operation has reached its stopped state. Use a fresh forWhom for each status check and state-changing command.

verification.issue_3_execution: After each Issue #3 comment, inspect the corresponding Actions execution and the command output file under workspaces/terminalruns/{forWhom}_{timestamp}.json.
verification.codespace_state: Read Codespace state with gh api 'user/codespaces/shiny-robot-v64x5jj4v4q2x96' --jq '.state'.
verification.result_policy: A posted comment or dispatched workflow alone does not prove the Codespace started. Report actual observed state, any execution errors, and whether MCP service connectivity was independently tested.

authority_boundary: This is an Applications project reference procedure, not an automatic change to ChatGPT Project Instructions. Its Issue #3 command payload is interpreted by the live GitHub workflow; recheck the current workflow if its contract changes.
